title: Fix PyPI publication in release workflow

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Investigating and implementing the release workflow fix on develop. Plan: disable semantic-release publish, add an explicit PyPI publish job gated on released=true, and remove upload_to_pypi from pyproject.toml. Validation on develop will be workflow wiring inspection plus a local package build; real end-to-end validation will happen after the approved main merge.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Implemented the release fix on develop. Changed .github/workflows/release.yml so the reusable semantic-release job runs with run_publish=false and added a separate publish_pypi job that depends on release, checks released=true, checks out the emitted tag, builds distributions, and publishes with pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish. Removed upload_to_pypi from pyproject.toml. Validation on develop: YAML and TOML structure checks passed, the workflow wiring assertions passed, git diff --check passed, and a local python -m build succeeded and produced both sdist and wheel.
